result:
All green: `bun run typecheck` passes, `bun test` runs 10 tests with 0 failures, and `bunx guren check` reports no failures.

I added a `published` boolean to posts and enforced draft visibility end to end. `db/schema.ts` gains `published: integer('published', { mode: 'boolean' }).notNull().default(false)`, with the generated migration `db/migrations/20260818045221_add_published_to_posts/migration.sql` extended by an `UPDATE posts SET published = true` so pre-existing rows (and any already-seeded demo blog) stay visible; `db/seeders/002_posts.ts` now inserts its samples with `published: true`. `Post.fillable` accepts `published`, `PostPayloadSchema` gains `published: z.boolean().optional().default(false)` (so a create without the field is a draft, and an edit save can publish or un-publish), and `PostResource` emits `published: boolean` on every post payload — list rows, post page, edit page and search results alike. In `PostController` a `visibleTo(viewerId)` grouping callback adds `(published = true OR authorId = viewer)` to both `index` (so pagination counts drafts out too) and `search` — as its own `where(...)` group so the keyword ORs can't swallow it — while `show` throws `NotFoundHttpException` for a draft the viewer didn't write, giving a plain 404 rather than a 403 that would confirm the draft exists; `edit`/`update`/`destroy` are untouched since `PostPolicy` already limits them to the author. The create and edit forms (`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx`, `Edit.tsx`) get a "Published" checkbox bound to that field, `Show.tsx` shows a Draft badge, and I added `tests/PostVisibility.test.ts` covering guest/stranger/author access to the list, search, post page and edit page plus create- and edit-form publishing, along with an ADR at `docs/adr/0002-posts-are-drafts-until-published.md` recording the 404-not-403 and author-sees-own-drafts decisions.
